pairs.ask: What do people see and hear in the first two seconds?

optionA.label: "Everyone says I was born lucky."
optionA.desc: Opens on me, small in the big hills, with the line on screen. Sets up the twist.

optionB.label: "The gods called me their favorite."
optionB.desc: Opens on a starry sky and DIOSPYROS, "fruit of the gods". Cheeky from frame one.

pairs.ask: Which look for the whole video?

optionA.label: Storybook, painterly
optionA.desc: Warm paper texture and soft painted edges, like an old picture book. I stay exactly on-model.

optionB.label: Clean, flat brand look
optionB.desc: Crisp shapes in the brand colours, matching my avatar and banner.

pairs.ask: How much tiger do we show?

optionA.label: Show the tiger
optionA.desc: He walks right into frame, big and sure of himself.

optionB.label: Only his shadow
optionB.desc: A long striped shadow slides across the lane. We never see him. Spookier, more fairy tale.

optionA.label: On-screen text
optionA.desc: Big, short lines on each frame. Works with the sound off, which is how most people scroll.

optionB.label: Voiceover feel
optionB.desc: Me telling it out loud, with small subtitles. Feels like a bedtime story. (Voice to be made; this is the feel.)

optionA.label: About 15 seconds
optionA.desc: Four beats: hills, tiger, stand still, wink. Quick enough to watch twice.

optionB.label: About 45 seconds
optionB.desc: The fuller tale: fruit of the gods, the tiger, the old Korean story of the tiger who ran from a dried persimmon, then the wink.

pairs.ask: What does it sound like underneath?

optionA.label: Gentle and warm
optionA.desc: Soft plucked strings and a slow, lullaby-like tune. The tiger moment goes quiet, then the wink gets one bright note.

optionB.label: Playful and bouncy
optionB.desc: Light marimba and a tiptoe beat. The tiger gets a comic sneaky rhythm, the wink lands on a little pop.

pairs.ask: The video ends on my wink. Then what?

optionA.label: Wink, then an end card
optionA.desc: After the wink, a clean card: my winking mark, @Machan10001 and "May all things go as you wish."

optionB.label: Wink is the last frame
optionB.desc: No end card. The wink holds for a beat and the video loops straight back to the start.

pairs.ask: How much do I explain? A few sly words, or the warm storyteller?

optionA.label: Few words, all mystery
optionA.desc: Public persona, street-art style: no explanation, the art speaks for itself. Just a line and a wink.

optionB.label: Warm storyteller
optionB.desc: Says hi, sets up the story and promises the wink.

pairs.ask: A little Thai, or all English?

optionA.label: A few Thai words
optionA.desc: Opens with สวัสดีครับ (hello) on screen and in the caption, and calls me a ลูกพลับ (persimmon).

optionB.label: English only
optionB.desc: Simple and universal for a first post.

optionA.label: Fable narrator
optionA.desc: "Once, in the hills..." A classic fairy-tale telling, about me.

optionB.label: Me, telling my own story
optionB.desc: First person, playful, a little mischievous. Sounds like a character, not a book.
